description.en: Understanding of ESD indications, target organs, knife types, injection strategies, dissection principles (marking, injection, cutting, dissection), traction, and expected outcomes prior to hands-on training.

criteria.en: Requires prompting to execute; recognises the need for esd theoretical knowledge but cannot yet perform reliably.
Performs esd theoretical knowledge independently to source-defined standards.
Teaches esd theoretical knowledge to trainees; handles atypical/complex cases.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of source-canonical ESGE ESD 2019 recommendations into trainee-assessable units. ESD 2019 does not enumerate competencies as separate objects; this frame is Evideris's design.
